content.short: Ample is a no-loss prize savings protocol paying weekly prizes from pooled deposit yield.
content.description: Deposits in Ample are pooled to generate yield, which is paid out as weekly prizes instead of being spread evenly across depositors. Participants accumulate tickets over time that set their odds in each draw, and principal stays withdrawable throughout. Payouts are funded entirely from the yield the vaults earn, so nobody's deposit funds another participant's win. Ample is live on Hyperliquid, Monad and Robinhood Chain.
content.meta: Ample is a no-loss prize savings protocol on Hyperliquid, Monad and Robinhood Chain that pays weekly prizes from pooled yield.
